Limits kept visible

Eight recent unfinished Task conversations across windows, plus visible exceptions. Repo/Wave primaries are outside that cap. Two concurrent preparations. No measured RAM budget. Large repositories do not prefetch every Task at once.

Restart, cold-return, Rex takeover and twenty-Task footprint remain unmeasured. The Wave reading pass could not find its authored files in its prepared checkout, though shared Wave status loaded. The earlier environment-sensitive Ghostty test crash remains recorded.
